seniors.seated_version: Seated sway to the rhythm of technobanda.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo and range of motion.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Male holds female's waist; female holds male's shoulders or waist.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Partnered, moving in place or around the dance floor.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Includes acrobatic dips and small jumps.
movement_profile.posture: Close hold, partners holding each other by the waist.

signature_moves.description: Male dancer dips the female partner backward toward the floor with a straight back.
signature_moves.name: Tombé

signature_moves.description: Small, galloping jumps mimicking a horse.
signature_moves.name: Caballito

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid without sufficient strength, timing, and coordination due to potential danger.

music_profile.sound_description: A driving, fast-paced fusion of traditional Sinaloan brass and modern electronic synthesizers, characterized by a rhythmic, double-time cumbia beat.

basic_steps: Establish a close hold with partner, hands on waist.
Execute small, alternating jumps to create a side-to-side sway.
Perform the tombé by dipping the partner backward with a straight back.
teaching.level_notes: Requires high strength, timing, and coordination.
